1.w: “Truly, truly, I say to you⁺, the one not entering through the door to the fold of the sheep, but going up another way, he is a thief and a robber.

2.w: But the one entering through the door is the shepherd of the sheep.

3.w: To this one the doorkeeper opens, and the sheep hear his voice. And he calls [his] own sheep by name and leads them out.

4.w: When he may bring out all [his] own, he goes before them, and the sheep follow him because they know his voice.

5.w: But they will never follow a stranger, but will flee from him, because they do not know the voice of strangers.”

6.w: Jesus spoke to them this allegory, but they did not know what it was that He was saying to them.

7.w: Therefore Jesus again said to them, “Truly, truly, I say to you⁺, I am the door of the sheep.

8.w: All, as many as came before Me, are thieves and robbers, but the sheep did not hear them.

9.w: I am the door. If anyone may enter through Me, he will be saved, and he will come in and will go out and will find pasture.

10.w: The thief does not come except so that he might steal and might kill and might destroy. I came so that they may have life, and may have [it] abundantly.

11.w: I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down His life for the sheep.

12.w: But the hired servant, not being the shepherd, whose own the sheep are not, sees the wolf coming and leaves the sheep and flees—and the wolf snatches them and scatters [them]—

13.w: because he is a hired servant and is not himself caring about the sheep.

14.w: I am the good shepherd, and I know My own, and My own know Me—

15.w: just as the Father knows Me and I know the Father—and I lay down My life for the sheep.

16.w: And I have other sheep that are not of this fold. It is necessary for Me to bring those also, and they will hear My voice, and there will be one flock [and] one shepherd.

17.w: Because of this, the Father loves Me, because I lay down My life so that I might take it again.

18.w: No one takes it from Me, but I lay it down of Myself. I have authority to lay it down, and I have authority to take it again. This commandment I received from My Father.”

19.w: Again there was division among the Jews because of these words.

20.w: And many of them were saying, “He has a demon and is insane. Why do you⁺ listen to Him?”

21.w: Others were saying, “These are not the sayings of one possessed by a demon. Is a demon able to open the eyes of the blind?”

22.w: Then the Feast of Dedication took place at Jerusalem. It was winter,

23.w: and Jesus was walking in the temple, in the porch of Solomon.

24.w: Therefore the Jews encircled Him and were saying to Him, “Until when do You hold our soul in suspense? If You are the Christ, tell us plainly.”

25.w: Jesus answered them, “I told you⁺, and you⁺ do not believe. The works that I do in the name of My Father, these testify about Me.

26.w: But you⁺ do not believe, because you⁺ are not of My sheep.

27.w: My sheep hear My voice, and I know them, and they follow Me.

28.w: And I give them eternal life, and never shall they perish to the age, and no one will snatch them out of My hand.

29.w: My Father, who has given [them] to Me, is greater than all, and no one is able to snatch [them] out of the hand of the Father.

30.w: I and the Father are one.”

31.w: Therefore the Jews took up stones again so that they might stone Him.

32.w: Jesus answered them, “I showed you⁺ many good works from the Father; because of which work of them do you⁺ stone Me?”

33.w: The Jews answered Him, “We do not stone You concerning a good work, but concerning blasphemy, and because You, being a man, make Yourself God.”

34.w: Jesus answered them, “Is it not written in your⁺ Law: ‘I said you⁺ are gods’?

35.w: If he called them gods to whom the word of God came—and the Scripture is not able to be broken—

36.w: do you⁺ say [of Him] whom the Father sanctified and sent into the world, ‘You blaspheme,’ because I said, ‘I am the Son of God’?

37.w: If I do not do the works of My Father, do not believe Me.

38.w: But if I do, even if you⁺ do not believe Me, believe the works, so that you⁺ may know and may understand that the Father [is] in Me and I in the Father.”

39.w: Therefore they were seeking again to seize Him, but He went forth out of their hand.

40.w: And He went away again beyond the Jordan to the place where John was baptizing at first, and He remained there.

41.w: And many came to Him and were saying, “John indeed did no sign, but everything that John said about this [man] was true.”

42.w: And many believed in Him there.
